explanation: It fires only at D1, when the previous trial was an a1 choice that went badly (no reward, or a reward that came through a rare a1-to-S2 transition): it is about 8-10 late in the episode (trials 85-99) and weaker earlier (0-6, often 0 before trial 50). It is 0 at every GO and D2 step, at D1 after a rewarded common a1 trial, and almost always 0 when the agent has been choosing a2.
